_comment: Template. Setup-NetGuard.ps1 writes the real config to netguard.config.json, which is gitignored. Secrets (webhook URL, SMTP password, API keys) are NEVER stored here - they live encrypted in state/secrets.json.

notify._comment: Severity floors decide what reaches you. Too low and you mute the channel; too high and you miss things. Discord carries the detail, SMS carries the wake-you-up.

ai._comment: The AI layer explains and prioritises; it never decides whether to alert. Everything keeps working with this disabled.

scan._comment: watchPaths is filled in by the setup wizard with your Downloads folder. On Linux use forward slashes, e.g. /home/you/Downloads.

remote._comment: Hosts to push agents to over WinRM. The collection point is a file share, not a listening service.
